title: Alignment leaves show derived wall, share and cpu under a column header
body:
The alignment leaves print the sum of per-thread durations, which reads as a bug beside the branch wall.

Print instead: wall = share × alignment wall (share is what threaded_time_pct already returns), the share, and cpu (the thread sum). The branch line carries '[T threads, cpu Ns, P% busy]' where busy = cpu / (wall × threads). No idle row; busy already says it.

The header sits on the tree rail with a dashed rule:

 └─ alignment: 201.34s (36.13%)   [48 threads, cpu 9,610s, 99.4% busy]
     │                        wall        %      cpu
     │                     -------   ------   ------
     ├─ cloud search       113.02s   56.13%   5,425s
     ├─ backward            34.20s   16.99%   1,642s
